output.summary: The function processes an input byte array to compute a 64-bit value based on a series of bitwise operations and returns the inverted result.

claims.text: Computes a 64-bit value using a series of bitwise operations on the input bytes.
Iterates over each byte in the input array and applies a series of bitwise operations to a 32-bit variable.
Does not modify the input array.
Does not modify the output array.
Returns the inverted 32-bit value as a 64-bit unsigned integer.
Uses the constant 0xf7179bf5 in the bitwise operations.
Uses the constant 0xffffffff as the initial value for the 32-bit variable.
